subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google presents Vertex AI as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection proves the current label is stale, but the reporter's proposed wording differs from current official Google wording and provider-name changes must avoid compatibility drift.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.
